verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents programmatic paths an agent can run without a person: skills are plain filesystem artifacts that Claude picks up once a SKILL.md exists, custom skills can be uploaded through the Skills API, and the Agent SDK can load plugins programmatically from local directories. The marketplace install is documented only as `/plugin install` slash commands inside Claude Code, with no documented headless or promptless mode. The hands-on keyless install used a third-party `npx skills` CLI, which does not count toward the product's own capability. missing for 10: a documented first-party non-interactive install command (e.g. a headless `/plugin install` equivalent or CLI flag), explicit promptless/no-confirmation guarantees, and first-party hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent-driven install.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end

citations.quote: Create a `SKILL.md` file with instructions, and Claude adds it to its toolkit.
Through the Agent SDK, you can programmatically load plugins from local directories to add capabilities to your agent sessions.
